Adjectives After Der, Die, Das: German A2 Practice

Study four German examples with English meanings, then try four questions and check the explained answers.

A2 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Understand the rule

After a definite article, adjective endings are mainly -e or -en. Use -e in nominative singular and in feminine/neuter accusative singular: der neue Mantel, das rote Fahrrad. Use -en in the other common definite-article combinations, including masculine accusative and all dative forms.

Common mistake to avoid

Do not give the adjective the strong ending when the definite article already shows the grammar: mit dem alten Koffer, not mit dem altem Koffer.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Der neue Mantel passt gut.The new coat fits well.
Worked example 2Das rote Fahrrad gehört Sima.The red bicycle belongs to Sima.
Worked example 3Ich nehme den kleinen Koffer.I take the small suitcase.
Worked example 4Wir sitzen in der warmen Küche.We sit in the warm kitchen.

Practice: fill in the gaps

Add the adjective ending to the word in brackets. Keep the definite article unchanged. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Question 1. Die ___ Tasche ist schwer. (blau)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: blaue

Feminine nominative after die takes -e.

Question 2. Er sucht den ___ Schlüssel. (klein)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: kleinen

Masculine accusative after den takes -en.

Question 3. Mit dem ___ Bus kommen wir schneller. (neu)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: neuen

Dative after the definite article takes -en.

Question 4. Das ___ Zimmer ist frei. (hell)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: helle

Neuter nominative after das takes -e.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
